## Why visit

An excellent antidote to an over-managed heritage itinerary: a rambling collection of small rooms, service hatches and a snug grandly called the War Office. Its art-school and John Lennon associations add context, but the surviving pub layout is the stronger reason for beer travellers to come. Choose a room and let the atmosphere develop instead of treating it as a Beatles photograph stop. It pairs naturally with the more ornate pubs nearby while offering an altogether less formal, comfortably unpolished setting.
